scope.routes: Storefront homepage, categories, catalogue/search/offers, collections, PDP, cart, checkout, about/contact and shared shell; administration excluded.

motion.name: feedback
motion.purpose: Shared button background and border transitions.

motion.name: editorial-reveal
motion.purpose: Once-only editorial/collection entrance at 8% intersection; visible by default, disabled for reduced motion.

layout.campaignMinHeight: Uploaded: aspect-ratio 2/1; 2.7/1 at 768px; full contained image. Editorial fallback: min-height 230px; 310px at 768px.
layout.categoryRail: Two-row photographic atlas; minimum columns 142px, 190px at 640px; four columns at 1024px; minimum height 190px, 250px at 768px.
layout.floatingContact: 48px; right 16px; bottom calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); at 768px: 56px, right/bottom 24px
layout.hero: 3fr carousel / minmax(240px,1fr) actual product at 1024px; stacked with compact horizontal product below.
layout.mobilePurchaseBars: PDP/cart fixed bottom calc(62px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), z-index 19; floating contact bottom calc(178px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); purchase bars return to normal flow at 768px.
layout.scrollbarNone: Native horizontal overflow retained; scrollbar-width:none and ::-webkit-scrollbar display:none, scoped to storefront.

merchandising.campaignPriority: Up to newest eight API-uploaded banners, newest identifier first; full uncropped containment. Two generated HTML-captioned editorial fallbacks only when uploads absent.
merchandising.imageBoundary: Generated campaign/category/editorial scenes are decorative; catalogue products and prices always come from API data.
merchandising.sharedCards: ProductCard and CompactProductCard share ProductPhoto/ProductPrice; full cards also appear in existing product grids.
merchandising.categoryImagery: Shared CategoryTile prefers uploaded category photography; otherwise generic scene atlas, deodorant or general/nail decoration, then icon. Generated scenes never replace exact product photos.
merchandising.productSpotlight: Separate HomeProductCarousel: up to four available real products, manual slides, actual photo/title/API summary/price; distinct from uploaded campaign artwork.
merchandising.brandPhoto: Use a real catalogue photo only when product brand/family brand matches or name begins with the brand. Without a match, show brand text; no generated logos or packs.

narrative.northStar: A little care. A better day.
narrative.overview: The approved blue Outfit/Heroicons system extends from V4 homepage merchandising through category, catalogue, PDP, cart, checkout and information routes. Shared CategoryTile, StorefrontIntro and product cards retain existing palette, real API content and commerce behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Confident blue actions and white product surfaces.
Real products, readable prices and honest availability.
Manual campaign navigation and restrained feedback.
Compact inline delivery, two-row photographic category atlas and floating contact above bottom navigation.
Uploaded campaigns first, complete artwork preserved; once-only editorial motion with visible default.
Shared page intros/category tiles and a separate real-product spotlight carousel.
dos: Do preserve existing commerce behavior and URLs.
Do distinguish generated editorial decoration from real product photos.
donts: Do not restore superseded green or historical screenshot authority.
Do not invent products, prices, stock or service claims.
Do not fill conditional merchandising modules with fabricated products, prices, banners or brands.
